summary: BioLineRx Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on May 22, 2026, attaching a press release announcing data presentations on GLIX1 at the ASCO 2026 Annual Meeting. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer report of a press release regarding clinical trial data. No transaction, activism, restructuring, or corporate event occurs. No deal terms, stakeholders, or strategic changes are involved. This is a standard disclosure of scientific progress.
